 How to Watch Spurs vs Rockets

 San Antonio enters the matchup looking to bounce back from a disappointing 116-104 loss to the Oklahoma City Thunder in its season opener. Victor Wembanyama struggled offensively, scoring just 12 points on 1-of-13 shooting, although he contributed 13 rebounds and six blocks. Stephon Castle led the Spurs with 24 points, while rookie Dylan Harper added 18 in his NBA debut. With Wembanyama looking to return to form and De'Aaron Fox helping lead the backcourt, San Antonio will look to secure its first victory of the 2026-27 season.

 Houston got off to a much better start, defeating the Dallas Mavericks 128-110 behind impressive performances from Kevin Durant and Jabari Smith Jr., who scored 30 points apiece. Alperen Sengun added 23 points and 10 rebounds, while Fred VanVleet recorded 11 assists in his return from a torn ACL that sidelined him last season. The Rockets enter the season with championship aspirations, and Friday's matchup provides an early opportunity to prove themselves against another talented Western Conference opponent. Durant's return to Austin, where he played college basketball at Texas, adds another intriguing storyline to an already exciting matchup.
